clan-war.specific_finding: The summary determines which player acts first and then alternates unit movement. The early boxed-game review instead rolls initiative separately for every unit, permits leader adjustments, and moves units in initiative order. The summary also omits the custom thirty-card tactical deck and the orders, additional cavalry movement and reserve movement phases described by the source. These change central turn decisions. This finding covers the early boxed game; it does not certify later Daimyo Edition rules.
